COM_definition: Stored mass-weighted COM velocity; course atan2(-vz,vx). Each control averages its ten recorded5ms samples.
completion_definition: Earliest end of80complete post-change controls with mean projection>=0.006m/s and abs shortest signed course error<=5deg; maximum depth<=0.001m and tilt<=10deg through that instant. First possible delay4s.
final_rule: Authoritative cases.csv pass is unchanged; early qualifying windows remain transient when the final case fails.
last_window_definition: Last available full4s after the change, including early-stopped cases; not automatically the registered final16-20s window.
actual_change_definition: Last4s COM course minus mean COM course over controls21-40; achieved_turn_from_initial_request instead uses the original requested heading.
direction_convention: Positive course/request is left; negative is right. Final-angle classification does not claim unwrapped full revolutions.
lane_note: Turn lane is distance from the request line through the initial COM; it is descriptive, not a turning pass criterion.
